name: Jack Graystone
original_name: ジャック・グレイストーン
source:
[i]"How about a story where a hunter strikes it rich?"[/i]

[b]Occupation:[/b] Vampire hunter
[b]Interest:[/b] Gambling
[b]Weapon:[/b] Whip

A vampire hunter who will risk anything for money.

He earns a decent amount of coin as a vampire hunter, but he's just as quick to spend it on gambling and drinking. In a world where you never know when you're going to die, he believes it fruitless to hoard money.

He and Eileen were classmates at the seminary.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/redbell/english/characters/?page=jack]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
